Server logic for the enrichmentDotPlot module

Source: R/enrichmentDotPlot_module_server.R
enrichmentDotPlotServer.Rd

This module builds an enrichment dot plot with VizModules::plotthis_DotPlotServer() and renders it as an interactive plotly figure. The incoming enrichment results are augmented with a numeric GeneRatio column, a neg_log10_pvalue column, and a categorical grouping column before being handed to the wrapped DotPlot server (see enrichmentDotPlotInputsUI() for details).

Usage

enrichmentDotPlotServer(
  id,
  data,
  hide.inputs = NULL,
  hide.tabs = NULL,
  defaults = NULL
)

Arguments

id

The ID for the Shiny module.

data

A reactive returning the enrichment results data frame.

hide.inputs

A character vector of input IDs to hide.

hide.tabs

A character vector of tab names to hide.

defaults

A named list of default values used when resetting the inputs. Typically the same list passed to enrichmentDotPlotInputsUI().

Value

The moduleServer function for the enrichmentDotPlot module.

See also

plotthis::DotPlot(), VizModules::plotthis_DotPlotServer(), enrichmentDotPlotInputsUI(), enrichmentDotPlotOutputUI(), enrichmentDotPlotApp()

Author

Jacob Martin, Jared Andrews

Examples

library(sciVizModules)
if (interactive()) enrichmentDotPlotApp()
